The problem

What is the real problem?

The true problem: 5 whys
Problem statement: customers contact the bank for dispute status, fee explanations and card replacement because the app does not answer these questions: about 27,000 avoidable contacts a month, growing 15% a yearGUIDE.
1Why? Customers call because they cannot find the answer themselves.
2Why? The app shows balances only, and FAQs are generic.
3Why? The question is personal: "why was I charged 75 EGP on 4 September?"
4Why? Agents answer by reading the same policy plus the customer's transactions, a pattern AI can follow.
5Why? Hypothesis: most of these contacts need information, not a decision.
Step 5 is unprovenD3 Not yet tested
It will never: move money, waive fees, decide disputes, give credit or financial advice, or answer for anyone but the logged-in customerPRD.
Is it a real problem?
  • The brief: 60% of 45,000 contacts are 3 questionsPRDD2, with no breakdown yetA5
  • No Egyptian bank bot found answering "why was I charged this?" from the customer's own transactionsMKT
  • Disputes and lost cards often need an action or a person's reassuranceA5D3
  • People evidence: none yet; bank interviews planned Not yet tested
Why solve it now?
  • Contacts grow 15% a year, faster than headcountGUIDED4
  • The market is consolidating: Salesforce agreed to buy FinMKT
  • The window is real but short: Intella with Visa, Kore.ai in Middle East banksMKT
  • Egypt's second AI strategy (2025 to 2030) and trustworthy-AI guidelines (Mar 2026)REG

Why it might work
Current behaviour
  • Customers already ask these 3 questionsPRD
  • Agents answer from the same policy plus transactions, a pattern AI can followGUIDE
  • The customer taps the exact record instead of typing detailsSTATUS
User psychology
  • A first-message card sets what it can and can't doUX
  • "Why this answer?" earns trustUX
  • Control: "Talk to a person" is always visibleUX
  • 👍/👎 under every answer; 👎 offers a personUX
Lesson from Klarna: escalated customers arrived angry because they had to repeat themselves. A handoff summary is cheap and fixes thisMKT.
Benefits for the company
  • Capacity for growth, not layoffs: about 18 hires avoidedGUIDE
  • One adapter: the model can be swapped; learning lives in Nova's filesPRD
  • Model, prompt and sources stored with each answerGUIDE
  • AI is the smallest cost: about EGP 81 a monthROI
  • Kill switch: one setting sends every message to a personPRD

Three automation modes
  • Off: every message to a person, no AIUX

  • Auto-answer low-risk: checked answers go straight outUX

What the agent gets on handoff
